bound_probe: Forty public margin designs at eight lengths, each with five exact-root Chernoff exponents. Floating displays are discovery only; script imports evolving production modules, not a frozen historical runtime.
greedy_probe: Six group sizes; exact weighted type counts, floating entropy and limiting-risk direction only.
initial_search: Actual script bytes retained; 156 full/dithered starts had no point of entropy <=4, so selection raised ValueError and wrote no JSON. Original console output was not saved as a file.
pair_probe_compression: gzip preserves the complete original JSON bytes after decompression; deterministic mtime=0, no transport timing claim.
revised_search: 486 bounded floating Lloyd-style runs, 239 distinct maps, selects a constant-pair tie choice. Other maps and trajectories retained, no global-optimality claim.
scope: Inspected post-hoc offline search, not independent model trials or a preregistered performance study.
